rows.grounds: compound form denoting the inner row

items.question: Which ritual paths and inner rows must be abandoned for outside practice?
premises: inner row and path are abandoned
items.inference: The verse directs abandonment of inner-row and path, leaving outside practice.
uncertainties: exact doctrinal referent of antarvāraṃ remains uncertain
whether bahistu is locative or adverbial is uncertain
items.plain_english: Abandoning both the inner row and the path, one practices outside instead.
